title: Sonata
identity: Erland von Koch’s *Sonata* (1985) is for alto saxophone and piano. Swedish National Library catalog information in the existing catalog snapshot gives a 1987 Dorn Publications record with an alternative viola version. MusicWeb’s review of *Single Reed Expressions* confirms the saxophone instrumentation, and the 2026 California State University, Sacramento saxophone-studio program includes the sonata.

evidence.claim: Swedish national catalog record in the current catalog source identifies the alto saxophone-and-piano sonata, alternative viola version, and Dorn publication dated 1987.
Review identifies the 1985 sonata as for alto saxophone and piano in its contemporary saxophone compilation.
California State University, Sacramento saxophone-studio program includes Erland von Koch among its recital repertoire.
evidence.source_name: California State University, Sacramento recital program

review_focus: The score and recording would resolve the 1985 composition and 1987 alternative-version publication dates and establish solo-part demands; notation was not inspected.
collection_flag: Documented alto saxophone sonata with an alternative viola version and university saxophone recital use.
gaps: No score sample or specific recording track for this sonata located; movements, duration, and technical demands remain unverified.
